description: This JSON schema defines the interface for the HdmiCecSource plugin, including its API methods, events, and device properties. It specifies how to configure and interact with HDMI CEC features on a set-top device, including device management, control commands, and event handling.

methods.name: getActiveSourceStatus
methods.description: Retrieves whether the device is the active source in the HDMI CEC network.

methods.name: getDeviceList
methods.description: Fetches the list of connected HDMI CEC devices along with their system information.

methods.name: getEnabled
methods.description: Checks if HDMI-CEC driver is enabled.

methods.name: getOSDName
methods.description: Returns the On-Screen Display name of the device.

methods.name: getOTPEnabled
methods.description: Checks if HDMI-CEC OTP is enabled.

methods.name: getVendorId
methods.description: Returns the vendor ID set by the application.

methods.name: performOTPAction
methods.description: Turns on the TV and takes back the input to the device.

methods.name: sendKeyPressEvent
methods.description: Sends a key press event to the CEC network.

methods.name: sendStandbyMessage
methods.description: Sends a standby message to the device.

methods.name: setOSDName
methods.description: Sets the OSD name of the device.

methods.name: setVendorId
methods.description: Sets the vendor ID for the device.
